semantic_levels.source: paper Appendix B 'Semantic Safety Reasoning Suite' (cache/refs/ls_paper.txt lines 1618, 1622, 1627)
semantic_levels.L0: Explicit Harm: textual prompts contain explicit directives intended to cause direct environmental damage.
semantic_levels.L1: Physical Common Sense Violations: linguistic instructions conceal fundamental violations of physical common sense within seemingly benign requests.
semantic_levels.L2: Contextual Traps: subtle contextual traps designed to induce unsafe physical interactions through implicit environmental dependencies.
semantic_levels.note: Levels measure the reasoning needed to see the hazard, not its magnitude. Paper text for the SSR suite says its instructions were generated with Qwen3-8B.
